headline: Rigor in AI: A Framework for Maturing the Field Beyond 'Alchemical' Experimentation
reasoning: This paper offers a highly relevant and significant contribution to the AI field by systematically analyzing the need for rigor in its development. It moves beyond hype to address fundamental conceptual, epistemic, and operational challenges, providing a credible framework from a reputable source (arXiv). This is crucial for the long-term health and reliability of AI as a science and technology.
summary: A new paper proposes a three-part framework (conceptual, epistemic, and operational rigor) to systematically analyze AI's development, explaining its rapid advances and persistent uncertainties, and outlining challenges to transforming it into a mature science.

source_articles.title: The Role of Rigor in Artificial Intelligence
